name: Hanayome Kakushi
original_name: 花嫁隠 ─ハナヨメカクシ─
source:
The protagonist (you) was born and raised in a certain mountain village.
She had hoped to leave for the world outside of the village, but she was chosen as the bride of the god "Kakushi-sama", who has been worshipped as a mountain god since ancient times.

The protagonist is unable to give up on the outside world.
Under the watchful eye of her doctor, Dr. Kagami, she tries to escape from the village before the day of the ceremony, but for some reason, every night she has strange dreams...
(Official game page - novelgame MTL)
translation:
主角（你）在某个山村出生并长大。她本想离开村子、看看外面的世界，却被自古以来受人尊奉为山神的“觉士大人”选为新娘。

她无法放弃外面的世界，在医生加贺美博士的监视下，试图赶在仪式当天前逃离村庄。然而不知为何，她每天晚上都会做奇怪的梦……

[官方游戏页面：Novelgame]
